newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia builders target niche markets - S&P.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia builders target niche markets - S&P.

text.p: Standard and Poor's said on Thursday local building materials firms are targetting Asia and the United States partly to mitigate the adverse effect higher local price competition is having on their credit quality.
S&P said low-cost, market leadership positions would determine the success of the growth strategies of Australia's building material firms.
It said examples of products and geographic focus for Australian building material companies include:
- CSR Ltd rated "A" is adding pipe operations in the U.S. and plasterboard plants in Asia.

- Boral Ltd rated "A" is divesting many non-core offshore businesses to finance several large purchases especillay in the U.S. brick industry and continues to review its remaining European operations.
